facts.statement: Tarbosaurus possessed a unique locking mechanism in its lower jaw where a ridge on the angular bone articulated with the dentary bone.

facts.statement: Tarbosaurus had the smallest arms relative to body size of all tyrannosaurid family members.

facts.statement: It is debated whether tyrannosaurid remains found in the Djadokhta Formation belong to Tarbosaurus, with some researchers listing them as a dubious species.

facts.statement: Some researchers suggest that tyrannosaurid remains in the Djadokhta Formation represent passing taxa foreign to the region rather than resident Tarbosaurus.

facts.statement: Tarbosaurus belongs to the theropod subfamily Tyrannosaurinae within the family Tyrannosauridae.
